description: Edit a profile you own (needs a key). Send `markdown`, a whole OpenProfile.md that replaces what you wrote before, or any of `name`, `headline`, `identity` (key: value, null removes), `sections` (name: body, `none` removes), `handle`, `public`. What you write wins over every source and survives every re-read.

identity.description: Identity keys: Kind, Web, Email, Location, ...; null removes

public.description: Listed and pulled by other directories

sections.description: Section bodies by name (accounts, topics, broadcast, guest, ...); the word none removes one

name: update_profile
